2610.05689.title: Toward AI Trustworthiness: Finding Analytically Proven Forward-Invariant Sets for AI-Controlled Systems
2610.05689.paper_summary: Neural-network (NN) controllers are increasingly used in nonlinear control systems, but their highly nonlinear behavior makes them difficult to explain and verify, raising trustworthiness concerns in safety- and mission-critical applications. A key step toward certifiable trustworthiness is to find a Forward-Invariant Set (FIS): a state-space region such that any trajectory starting inside remains inside. If the FIS excludes unsafe states, safety can be guaranteed for initial states within it. Finding an analytically proven FIS for a given AI-controlled system with a fixed controller is difficult. We propose a framework that uses an Invertible Neural Network (INN) to transform the original state space into a latent space where a regular-shaped FIS is more likely to exist. We train the INN so that a preferred hyper-rectangular candidate becomes invariant in the latent space, then formally verify it. We prove that, whenever verification succeeds, both the latent-space candidate and its inverse-transformed counterpart in the original state space are analytically proven FISs. We evaluate the approach on 45 AI-controlled systems across three representative control testbeds. Our method finds certified FISs for all 45 systems, whereas an adapted state-of-the-art baseline finds none. It is also faster on 40 of the 45 systems, and the centers of the resulting FISs roughly match domain-expert preferences.
2610.05689.paper_summary_zh: 神經網絡（NN）控制器在非線性控制系統中的使用越來越普遍，但其高度非線性的行為使得它們難以解釋和驗證，這在安全和任務關鍵應用中引發了信任問題。朝向可認證信任度的一個關鍵步驟是找到一個前向不變集（FIS）：一個狀態空間區域，使得任何從內部開始的軌跡都保持在內部。如果 FIS 排除了不安全狀態，則可以保證其內部初始狀態的安全性。對於給定的 AI 控制系統，找到一個經過分析證明的 FIS 是困難的。我們提出了一個框架，使用可逆神經網絡（INN）將原始狀態空間轉換為潛在空間，在這裡，規則形狀的 FIS 更有可能存在。我們訓練 INN，使得一個首選的超矩形候選者在潛在空間中變得不變，然後對其進行正式驗證。我們證明，無論何時驗證成功，潛在空間候選者及其在原始狀態空間中的逆轉換對應物都是經過分析證明的 FIS。我們在三個代表性的控制測試平台上對 45 個 AI 控制系統評估了這種方法。我們的方法為所有 45 個系統找到了經過認證的 FIS，而一個改編的最先進基準則沒有找到任何。它在 45 個系統中的 40 個上也更快，且結果 FIS 的中心大致符合領域專家的偏好。
